description: This file defines the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Bot class, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice. It provides functionality to identify whether a user agent string corresponds to a known bot by matching against predefined signatures. It also includes a method to return the browser type as 'bot'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Bot
classes.description: Represents a user agent recognized as a bot, providing methods to detect bot signatures and identify the user agent type.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the provided user agent string matches known bot signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, which is 'bot' for this class.
